mapper.select: WITH RECURSIVE branch_tree (id, branch_name, branch_type, parent_id,sort_order,tenant_id) AS ( SELECT id, branch_name, branch_type, parent_id,sort_order,tenant_id FROM bbx_energy_branch WHERE id = #{branchId} AND status = 1 AND deleted = 1 AND tenant_id = #{tenantId} UNION ALL SELECT b.id, b.branch_name, b.branch_type, b.parent_id,b.sort_order,b.tenant_id FROM bbx_energy_branch b INNER JOIN branch_tree bt ON b.parent_id = bt.id WHERE b.status = 1 AND b.deleted = 1 AND b.tenant_id = #{tenantId} ) SELECT id, branch_name, branch_type, parent_id,sort_order,tenant_id FROM branch_tree ORDER BY id
